finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Three cases failed, all in `order totals`. One bug caused all three.

`orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount base. It should tax what the customer pays. Its own doc comment said so already.

Only rows with both a discount and a tax could expose it. There were three.

Fix at [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39).

Next: nothing. Suite is clean.
